create_dataset_make_circles: create nested circle dataset using make_circles with 1000 samples and 0.05 noise
split_data_train_test: split dataset into stratified train and test sets using train_test_split
transform_data_kernel_pca: transform data with KernelPCA using RBF kernel, gamma=10, and inverse transform enabled
transform_data_pca: transform data with PCA into 2 principal components for linear projection
reconstruct_data_inverse_transform: reconstruct original data from projected features using inverse_transform
